name: SIFT
summary: A granular synth and recorder. Everything it hears is cut into grains and sorted by sound. Tilt to pick grains, turn from a tuned pattern on the beat to a wild cloud, shake to scatter.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Takes up to 20 s of sound in PSRAM. It can load the Samplooler's saved slots as material.
status_note: Flashed on 2026-10-22: it starts and keeps up (CPU 16 %, internal RAM 150 KB free, the 20 s corpus in PSRAM). Not played much yet.
